note: Both sets are numerically accurate against Table 6-1: every value, unit and elevation/HtFract pairing I checked matches the table rows. Set A spreads its claims across mass density, fore-aft/side-to-side stiffness and inertia, torsional and axial stiffness, and its quotes consistently restate the full row (elevation, HtFract, property, value), so each claim is bound to its condition. Set B devotes 10 of 25 claims to trivial 0.0 center-of-gravity offsets and several of its quotes use ellipses (e.g. 'TwSSStif (N•m2) ... 534.82E+9') that never show the row the value comes from, leaving the stated elevation unsupported by the quote; it also labels fore-aft stiffness as 'forward-aft'. Set A therefore gives more substantive, better-supported coverage of the same table.
